description:
SMART Property is delighted to present No. 140 Leeson Street Upper, a stylish one-bedroom duplex apartment ideally located in the heart of the city. This beautifully designed residence spans two levels, with the ground floor serving as an elegant hallway entrance leading to the main living space above.

Upon entering, you are greeted by a spacious entrance hallway that showcases a charming feature fireplace, adding a touch of warmth and character to the space. The hallway also offers ample storage options, thoughtfully designed to accommodate utility appliances and keep the area organised and clutter-free. This combination of aesthetic appeal and practicality creates a welcoming first impression and sets the tone for the rest of the home.

Taking the stairs to the first floor of the home brings you to the heart of the residence. This level comprises a spacious double bedroom, a well-appointed main bathroom, a comfortable living room, and a modern kitchen/dining area. The stairs, living room, and bedroom are all fitted with soft grey carpet flooring, adding warmth and comfort to these key areas. Each room is thoughtfully designed to maximize comfort and functionality, making this floor the perfect space for both relaxation and entertaining.

The spacious double bedroom is furnished with a comfortable double bed and offers ample storage space, including wardrobes and a chest of drawers. Additionally, the room features a versatile vanity area that can also serve as a desk, providing a practical spot for getting ready. This well-appointed bedroom combines style and functionality to create a restful retreat.

The living area is a cozy and inviting space, furnished with comfortable couches ideal for relaxing or entertaining guests. A large window allows natural light to flood the room, creating a bright and airy atmosphere that enhances the overall warmth and comfort of this central living space.

The kitchen features elegant wooden cabinetry accented with stylish navy trim, combining classic and contemporary design elements. The flooring features durable lino designed with a tile pattern, offering the classic look of tiled floors with the comfort and practicality of lino. Adjacent to the kitchen is a cozy dining area furnished with a four-seater dining table, perfect for intimate meals or casual gatherings.

The main bathroom is fully equipped with a modern shower and is beautifully finished with white tiling throughout, creating a clean and fresh ambiance. Recently renovated, this space combines contemporary style with practical design, offering a bright and inviting environment for daily routines.

Set along the highly sought-after Leeson Street Upper, this duplex apartment enjoys an enviable position in one of Dublin’s most established and desirable neighbourhoods. The location combines the convenience of city living with a more relaxed residential character, with an excellent selection of cafés, restaurants and everyday amenities close by, while St. Stephen’s Green, Grafton Street and Dublin’s city centre are all within easy reach. 

The area is exceptionally well served by public transport, with several popular Dublin Bus routes operating along Leeson Street and nearby roads, including the 39, 46A, and 145, providing convenient connections across the city and beyond. The Luas Green Line is also readily accessible, with nearby stops at Ranelagh and St. Stephen’s Green, offering direct links from Brides Glen to Broombridge through the city centre. Additionally, DART and commuter rail services are available from nearby stations, further enhancing connectivity. With excellent walking and cycling routes and such a central location, 140 Leeson Street Upper offers an ideal base for enjoying everything Dublin has to offer.

Combining bright, spacious accommodation with a recently refurbished interior and an unrivalled city centre location, No. 140 Leeson Street Upper represents an outstanding opportunity to acquire a quality apartment in one of Dublin's most established residential locations.
Early viewing is therefore highly recommended to fully appreciate everything this superb apartment has to offer. For further information or to arrange a viewing, please contact SMART Property today
